title: Résumé
summary: Software engineer with about nine years of experience spanning financial data platforms and performance improvement, healthcare domain modelling and reusable systems, and building a startup product from scratch. My strength is turning complex business requirements into maintainable, extensible systems and carrying the work through design, development and operations.
facts: Based in Tokyo · available from October 2026
JLPT N2 · studying at a language school

ui.projectNote: Personal projects that I take from idea to development and release, using AI-assisted development to address needs from everyday life.

experience.summary: Contributed to a financial-regulation data platform for global business teams, from requirements analysis and technical design to data-processing and calculation frameworks, production delivery and operational support. Worked in English with quants, business analysts, project managers and overseas users to turn regulatory and business requirements into maintainable systems.
points: Built Java backend services for upstream data intake, ETL scheduling and data import into Opensee. Learned Spark and Scala from scratch and built a configurable ETL framework adopted by six business teams, supporting over 2,000 daily processing jobs.
Optimised Spark resource allocation and processing logic, reducing a workload of over 100 million records from about two hours to under 45 minutes.

Worked with business analysts, quants and users to clarify requirements and validate prototypes, delivering a Python framework for Basel SA-CVA capital calculations. Verified results against ISDA sample data and enabled global business teams to retrieve data and run calculations themselves.

Provided global production support and on-call coverage across time zones. Supported users in the US and other regions in English, coordinating with teams and vendors to resolve data delays, performance degradation and system incidents.
Independently identified the causes of four or more defects and performance issues and drove vendor fixes. Resolved a service slowdown affecting all users with the team.

Reduced manual work through Jenkins regression automation, enabling repeatable validation of calculation results after business changes. Contributed to production delivery through pre-release validation, operating procedures and data migration.
Handled task breakdown, developer guidance and code review. Documented and regularly shared implementation, operational and troubleshooting knowledge as a team reference for development and handover.

experience.summary: As a core developer, handled requirements analysis, technical and architectural design, task breakdown, implementation and production maintenance. Turned medical and operational expertise into reusable software capabilities for chronic-disease management, health questionnaires and genetic-test reports.
points: Led domain modelling for the chronic-disease platform, separating shared management workflows from disease-specific rules. Extended diabetes management to hypertension and supported rollout to agents across China.

Redesigned questionnaire evaluation and genetic-report systems, separating shared processing from frequently changing business rules. Enabled doctors to configure questionnaires in Excel, reducing delivery time from about two weeks to three days; enabled genetic-test specialists to configure, test and publish report rules themselves.

Led the team to release an insurance sales-channel system in one week, integrating customer management, inventory and third-party shipping systems to support order processing, dispatch and reconciliation.
Introduced Spring Boot, DDD, Spock and code review to the team, with unit tests for management plans and core business rules.

experience.summary: As the company's sole developer, built a construction-machinery repair platform from scratch around a WeChat official account, taking the initial product through development and release.
points: Implemented the workflow from an owner's repair request through fault confirmation to technician dispatch.
Owned requirements, system design, Java backend development, deployment and day-to-day operations.

projects.body: An iOS app for people living in Japan and studying Japanese, combining receipt-based expense tracking with real-life vocabulary learning. On-device OCR via Vision, storage in SQLite, and the user's own choice of AI provider through an API key held in Keychain.
An offline-first iPhone railway-travel app with itinerary timelines, offline route maps, GPS arrival reminders, and local travel journals. Trilingual, no account, no ads, data stays on the device.

A web app that connects with AI agents such as Codex and Claude Code through MCP, organising vocabulary, grammar and questions from study conversations into a structured personal learning knowledge base. Preserves knowledge beyond individual chats and uses it to generate JLPT review cards and exercises, with multilingual support and study records.

Independently designed and developed a personal haiku website to publish original poems inspired by everyday scenes and seasonal observations. Simple typography and generous spacing create a quiet reading experience for exploring and revisiting the poems.

MySQL, Redis, ClickHouse, Spark, ETL, Pandas
GCP Compute Engine, Jenkins Pipeline, Linux, Tomcat, JUnit, Spock
Swift, SwiftUI, SQLite, Vision OCR, Keychain, LLM API
